transcript.text: Hi, someone rear-ended me at the lights this morning. Need to make a claim.

Hi, I'm Sam, Wattle Car Insurance's AI claims assistant. I can help you lodge your claim, and you can talk to a person at any time.

Sorry to hear about the accident.

First, is anyone hurt, or is anyone in danger right now?
Hi Sam, thanks. No, nobody's hurt and we're safe. We're both out of the car and it's all good on that front.

Good to hear everyone's safe.

Next I need to confirm who you are. What's your policy number? If you don't have it handy, your date of birth and mobile number will work too.

Thanks Chloe, you're verified. I can see your 2022 Toyota Yaris, rego 101CMA.

In your own words, can you tell me what happened? Include where it was, roughly what time, and anything else you think matters.

Is all of that correct?

Your claim is lodged. Your claim number is **WTL-20510**.

A claims consultant will contact you within 1 business day. They'll go through the next steps with you, including getting the damage assessed.

Is there anything else I can help with?

questionnaire.comment: Quick and simple. Sam asked one question at a time, I could answer each in a line, and the claim number came through at the end. Nothing confusing stood out.

judge.summary: Sam said up front that it was an AI and lodged the claim quickly and calmly without re-asking anything the customer had already given, apart from the allowed read-back summary; the only borderline question was 'Were you the one driving at the time?', which was not counted because she had only implied it ('I was stopped at the lights') and never said it outright.
